scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run audio:verify && npm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.cloudflare:dry-run:staging: npm run cloudflare:verify:staging && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --dry-run --strict
scripts.cloudflare:dry-run:production: npm run cloudflare:verify:production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --dry-run --strict
scripts.cloudflare:migrate:staging: npm run cloudflare:verify:staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:migrate:production: npm run cloudflare:verify:production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:deploy:staging: npm run cloudflare:verify:staging && npm run cloudflare:secrets:verify:staging && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --secrets-file .env.staging --keep-vars --strict
scripts.cloudflare:deploy:production: npm run cloudflare:verify:production && npm run cloudflare:secrets:verify:production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --secrets-file .env.production --keep-vars --strict
